description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named AnimatorEvents that demonstrates how to use Android's animation framework, including handling AnimatorListener events and creating custom animated views.

classes.name: AnimatorEvents
classes.description: Main activity that sets up the UI and initializes a custom animated view to demonstrate animation events.

classes.name: AnimatorEvents.MyAnimationView
classes.description: A custom View subclass that manages animated objects (balls), handles animation lifecycle events, and renders the animated objects.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and binds button click handlers.

methods.name: createAnimation
methods.description: Creates and configures the AnimatorSet with position and alpha animations for the animated ball.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Begins the animation sequence, optionally ending immediately if specified.

methods.name: createBall
methods.description: Creates a drawable shape representing a ball with radial gradient coloring.

methods.name: onAnimationUpdate
methods.description: Updates the view during animation to reflect the current animated state.

methods.name: onAnimationStart
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the animation starts, such as updating UI indicators.

methods.name: onAnimationEnd
methods.description: Handles actions when the animation ends, updating UI indicators.

methods.name: onAnimationCancel
methods.description: Handles actions when the animation is canceled, updating UI indicators.

methods.name: onAnimationRepeat
methods.description: Handles actions when the animation repeats, updating UI indicators.
